summary_md: **Ramiro Luo ([@Ramiro32400440](https://x.com/Ramiro32400440/status/2115762129588642094))** introduces **PhysClosureBench** ([paper page](https://huggingface.co/papers/2610.21767)), which tests whether AI agents can organize scientific investigations in strong-field, attosecond and neighboring physics through to evidence-supported conclusions; the answer is not yet, at only 32%.

referenced_urls.title: Paper page - From Research Goals to Scientific Closure: Evaluating Agents Through Evidence-Supported Physics Research

relevance: Evaluates end-to-end scientific reasoning by agents.
